# `usage generate json`

- **Usage**: `usage generate json [FLAGS]`
- **Effect**: read-only
- **Source code**: [`cli/src/cli/generate/json.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/usage/blob/main/cli/src/cli/generate/json.rs)
